skills.name: Calculus foundations
skills.description: Algebra, functions, graphs, and prerequisite reasoning used in calculus.

skills.name: Limit concepts
skills.description: Interpret and estimate limits numerically, graphically, and symbolically.

skills.name: Limit techniques
skills.description: Evaluate limits using algebra, conjugates, factoring, and standard limit laws.

skills.name: Continuity
skills.description: Test continuity and reason about discontinuities and the intermediate value theorem.

skills.name: Derivative definition
skills.description: Use the difference quotient and interpret the derivative as a rate and slope.

skills.name: Basic derivative rules
skills.description: Apply constant, power, sum, exponential, and trigonometric derivative rules.

skills.name: Product rule
skills.description: Differentiate products and identify when the product rule is required.

skills.name: Quotient rule
skills.description: Differentiate quotients and simplify the resulting expression.

skills.name: Chain rule
skills.description: Differentiate composite functions and track inner derivatives.

skills.name: Implicit differentiation
skills.description: Differentiate implicit relations and solve for the requested derivative.

skills.name: Related rates
skills.description: Build and differentiate time-dependent constraints to relate changing quantities.

skills.name: Optimization
skills.description: Model and solve extrema problems using derivatives and domain reasoning.

skills.name: Curve analysis
skills.description: Use first and second derivatives to analyze shape, extrema, and concavity.

skills.name: Antiderivatives
skills.description: Find basic indefinite integrals and include constants of integration.

skills.name: Definite integrals
skills.description: Interpret and evaluate accumulated change and signed area.

skills.name: Fundamental theorem of calculus
skills.description: Connect differentiation and integration through both parts of the theorem.

skills.name: Substitution
skills.description: Recognize reverse-chain-rule structure and evaluate integrals by substitution.

skills.name: Properties of exponents
skills.description: Simplify and rewrite expressions using integer and rational exponent laws.

skills.name: Factoring
skills.description: Factor common factors, trinomials, special products, and polynomial expressions.

skills.name: Fractions / compound fractions
skills.description: Simplify arithmetic and algebraic fractions, including compound fractions.

skills.name: Rational expressions
skills.description: Simplify and operate on rational expressions while tracking restrictions.

skills.name: Solving polynomial equations
skills.description: Solve polynomial equations by factoring and other algebraic techniques.

skills.name: Linear equations
skills.description: Solve and interpret one-variable linear equations.

skills.name: Linear/nonlinear inequalities
skills.description: Solve linear, polynomial, and rational inequalities and express their solution regions.

skills.name: Function notation and evaluating functions
skills.description: Interpret function notation and evaluate formulas at specified inputs.

skills.name: Domain and range
skills.description: Determine domains and ranges from formulas, graphs, and contextual restrictions.

skills.name: Function composition
skills.description: Build and evaluate composite functions while tracking their domains.

skills.name: Inverse functions
skills.description: Find and verify inverse functions and understand one-to-one restrictions.

skills.name: Parent functions and graph transformations
skills.description: Translate, reflect, stretch, and compress standard parent-function graphs.

skills.name: Average rate of change
skills.description: Compute and interpret average rate of change over an interval.

skills.name: Logarithm properties
skills.description: Expand, condense, and evaluate logarithmic expressions using log laws.

skills.name: Exponential equations
skills.description: Solve exponential equations using common bases and logarithms.

skills.name: Logarithmic equations
skills.description: Solve logarithmic equations and reject values outside the domain.

skills.name: Unit circle
skills.description: Use radian angles and unit-circle coordinates to evaluate trigonometric functions.

skills.name: Trig graphs
skills.description: Analyze amplitude, period, phase shift, and vertical shift in trigonometric graphs.

skills.name: Trigonometric equations
skills.description: Solve trigonometric equations over specified intervals.

skills.name: Trigonometric identities
skills.description: Simplify and verify trigonometric identities using fundamental relationships.
